title: Wines I've Tried
description: A personal reference transcribed and expanded from a wine list the user uploaded. Restaurant/list descriptions and independent sommelier suggestions are clearly distinguished.

wines.intro: Playful ancestral-method sparkling red with fizzy berry fruit and a savory edge.
wines.nose: Hibiscus, strawberry candy and bubble gum.
wines.palate: Juicy red plum skin and bright berries with lively bubbles.
wines.aeration: Chill, open carefully and serve immediately for its gentle sparkle.
wines.personalNote: Ancestral-method Lambrusco with hibiscus, strawberry candy, bubblegum and red plum skins; the playful label is by a child named Willow.
wines.pairingBasis: Suggested pairing: the wine's bubbles and acidity cut through rich cured meat and cheese.
wines.sourceLabel: Grape Witches Denny Bini Willa cuvée details
wines.imageVintageNote: Actual Willa label photographed; retailers list the wine as non-vintage, while your list calls it 2023.
wines.vintageNote: Treat 2023 as the year recorded on your wine list, not an independently confirmed vintage.

wines.intro: An orange Chardonnay from Mendoza with floral lift, phenolic grip and refreshing acidity.
wines.nose: Orange blossom, waxed lemon, beeswax and tropical white fruit.
wines.palate: Textural, lightly tannic and medium-to-full, with citrus peel and a juicy saline edge.
wines.aeration: Serve cool, not icy; a large white-wine glass shows its skin-contact texture.
wines.personalNote: Deep gold, perfumed skin-contact Chardonnay: waxed lemon, beeswax and orange blossom, with a gripping, juicy finish. The list notes organic farming, vegan production and no added sulfites.
wines.pairingBasis: Suggested for the wine's skin-contact tannin and citrus freshness; regional producer advice also recommends savory Argentine dishes.
wines.imageVintageNote: Exact El Zorrito Naranjo label; printed vintage may differ from 2024.
wines.vintageNote: The uploaded tasting note says about 40 days on skins; other winemaker/importer documents cite approximately 45 days.

wines.intro: A copper-pink natural wine sitting stylistically between a rosé and an orange wine.
wines.nose: Prickly pear, dried herbs, thyme and potpourri.
wines.palate: Fragrant, spicy and lightly smoky, with assertive acidity.
wines.finish: Fresh and savory, with a smoky-herbal impression.
wines.aeration: Serve cool; let the wine open in the glass before judging its herbal notes.
wines.personalNote: An aromatic, spicy and smoky Chilean wine, described as halfway between rosé and orange wine, with prickly pear, thyme, potpourri and pronounced acidity.
wines.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions for aromatic skin-contact fruit and savory acidity.
wines.sourceLabel: Grape Witches Strange Grapes Nextdoor Rosie
wines.imageVintageNote: Verified Nextdoor Rosie cuvée photograph, not verified as a 2020 label.
wines.vintageNote: 2020 is preserved from the uploaded list; no independent confirmation that this product photo matches that vintage.

wines.intro: A rare dry Moscato with fragrant flowers, a brief skin maceration and a salty coastal finish.
wines.palate: Fully dry, lightly textured, with savory fruit and subtle coastal salinity.
wines.aeration: Serve lightly chilled; avoid ice-cold temperatures that mute the aromatics.
wines.personalNote: Two days of skin contact create a lightly structured dry Moscato, still floral with honeysuckle and peach, then savory, salty and refreshing.
wines.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions for delicate aromatic white wine and Sicilian coastal food.
wines.sourceLabel: Il Mortellito official Viaria production details
wines.vintageNote: The producer confirms 100% Moscato di Noto and two days of skin contact.
